{"metadata":{"description":"Dynamic model routing for DSH subagents, with continuable spawn sessions and one-shot fork support.","id":"gh:1340075177","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-subagent-router","slug":"XMoon/dsh-subagent-router","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Dynamic model routing for DSH subagents, with continuable spawn sessions and one-shot fork support."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @xmoon76/dsh-subagent-router"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A model-facing DSH plugin that starts a **subagent on a model-selected LLM provider and model**. The"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" model picks the route (`provider`/`model`); the deployment owns the subagent backend (`subagentProv"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ider`, default `spawn`), the default scheduling policy (`backgroundMode`), and the route allowlist ("},{"id":"p4s4","text":"`allowedProviders`). Per-call scheduling is overridable with the optional `run_in_background` parame"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ter, exactly like the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` tools. Later turns of a continuable "},{"id":"p4s6","text":"child reuse the official `send_message` / `list_agents` / `interrupt_agent` tools from `@deepseek-ai"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"/dsh-tool-subagent-control`; background one-shot jobs are collected with the official `job_output` /"},{"id":"p4s8","text":" `job_kill` tools from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Installation (as a DSH profile bundle)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"This package ships as a DSH **profile bundle**: its `cordis.patch.yml`
(`dsh.bundle.patch`) inserts "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"TWO router rows into the profile composition
automatically — `tool-subagent-router` (spawn + continu"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"able, `subagent_route`)
and `tool-subagent-router-fork` (fork + one-shot, `subagent_fork_route`).
Re"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"quires a profile whose bundles include `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` (every
shipped `web`/`headless` templ"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ate does) — the `subagents` registry and its
`spawn`/`fork` backends come from that base layer."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The command installs the package into the profile and adds it to the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles`"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" layer list; on the next boot its patch inserts both rows
with the defaults below. To override defau"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"lts, patch the same row ids in the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the row's whol"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"he same row ids in the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the row's whole `config`):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Usage walkthrough"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The following flow is a practical model-facing invocation. Confirm that the profile has registered t"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"he router tools (`subagent_route` / `subagent_fork_route`) and that the selected provider/model rout"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"e is configured before dispatching."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Start a continuable child (background by default)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"`subagent_route` requires `description` / `prompt` / `provider` / `model`.
The model chooses only th"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e LLM route; deployment configuration still owns the
backend and the default scheduling policy:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"A continuable result acknowledges inbox acceptance and returns a durable id; it
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Why this package"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` binds one instance to one fixed child `agentOptions` ("},{"id":"p17s2","text":"deployment-fixed provider/model). This plugin moves the LLM route choice into the model's hands whil"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"e keeping every capability owned by the DSH seam: it is a thin Consumer over `ctx.subagents.startCon"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"tinuable()` / `ctx.subagents.start()` and `ctx.jobs`, and does not re-implement continuation, sessio"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ns, persistence, authority, jobs, or queues. Scheduling and lifecycle semantics otherwise mirror the"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" authority, jobs, or queues. Scheduling and lifecycle semantics otherwise mirror the official tools."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The registered router schemas (`subagent_route` / `subagent_fork_route`):
`description`, `prompt`, `"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"provider`, `model` (all required) plus the optional
`run_in_background` override. The `description`/"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"`prompt` wording follows the
backend provider's `inheritsParentContext`: a fresh child is told to pr"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ovide a
complete standalone prompt; a forked child is told it already sees completed
turns. Continua"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ble instances document the `true` default of
`run_in_background`, the settlement notice, and the exp"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"licit foreground
override; one-shot instances document the `false` default and the job id
collected "},{"id":"p19s7","text":"with `job_output` / `job_kill`. No `api_key`, `base_url`,
`max_tokens`, or backend/mode parameters e"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"`job_output` / `job_kill`. No `api_key`, `base_url`,
`max_tokens`, or backend/mode parameters exist."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`started subagent <id>` (continuable), the child's final text (foreground), or
`started background s"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ubagent job <id>` (background). Continuable results carry
no child reply; the child's transcript by "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"its id is the source of what it did,
and its settlement notice arrives independently."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **No mid-session model switching** — `provider`/`model` are fixed at creation; the durable descrip"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"tor persists them, so a resumed Activation still uses the creation-time route.
- **No model discover"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"y tool** — the model must already know the configured provider/model ids; a read-only discovery tool"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" is deferred.
- **A continuable child started in the background cannot be synchronously collected by"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" the initiating tool call** — its settlement arrives through the continuation notice mechanism and i"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ts transcript remains available by subagent id; use `run_in_background: false` when the next action "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"depends on the result.
- **`maxTokens` is not durable** — per-activation budgets are not persisted i"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"n the DSH continuable descriptor, so the tool does not expose them.
- **Only configured LLM adapters"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"/routes can be used** — the child route must resolve at request time; `provider`/`model` validity ma"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"y fail only when the child's route is resolved (no `listModels()` hard whitelist by design).
- **Con"},{"id":"p23s11","text":"tinuation controls require the official control tool** — `send_message` / `list_agents` / `interrupt"},{"id":"p23s12","text":"_agent` come from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control`, mounted separately.
- **Background one-s"},{"id":"p23s13","text":"hot jobs require the official jobs stack** — `ctx.jobs` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs` + a registry like `"},{"id":"p23s14","text":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs-local`) and the `job_output` / `job_kill` tools (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs`)"},{"id":"p23s15","text":"; a background call without them fails loud.
- **One-shot output is not streamed** — the run's final"},{"id":"p23s16","text":" output is returned once the child settles; intermediate steps stay in the child's transcript.
- **O"},{"id":"p23s17","text":"utput schema uses the DSH tools value-schema dialect** — the canonical foreground `output` is `{ typ"},{"id":"p23s18","text":"e: 'array', items: { type: 'json' } }`, where `'json'` is `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`'s Schemastery-bas"},{"id":"p23s19","text":"ed value type (the same dialect the official `tool-subagent` uses), not a bare JSON-Schema keyword; "},{"id":"p23s20","text":"only DSH's tool registry consumes it."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Prerequisites"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Node.js ≥ 22 and npm. All DSH peer dependencies resolve from the npm registry
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"`0.1.0-rc.x`), so no `deepseek-harness` checkout is
required."}],"truncated":true}
